import os
from collections import OrderedDict
import openpyxl

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/575-16/1_575-16_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/575-16_0_143f27d1/1_575-16_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Collect the vertical Student Code / Class Code data from columns A:B
groups = OrderedDict()
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    student = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    class_code = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value

    if student is None or class_code is None:
        continue
    if str(student).strip().lower() == "student code" or str(class_code).strip().lower() == "class code":
        continue

    if student not in groups:
        groups[student] = []
    groups[student].append(class_code)

# Answer position: Sheet1!G11:R13
start_row, start_col = 11, 7   # G11
max_rows, max_cols = 3, 12     # G:R = 12 columns

# Clear only the allowed answer range
for r in range(start_row, start_row + max_rows):
    for c in range(start_col, start_col + max_cols):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = None

# Write horizontal transposed result:
# first column = Student Code, subsequent columns = that student's Class Codes
for i, (student, classes) in enumerate(groups.items()):
    if i >= max_rows:
        break
    ws.cell(row=start_row + i, column=start_col).value = student
    for j, class_code in enumerate(classes[:max_cols - 1]):
        ws.cell(row=start_row + i, column=start_col + 1 + j).value = class_code

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
